concerns.text: Task T001a is marked [P] (parallel‑safe) but depends on the preceding task T001 which creates the project directory layout. Running it in parallel could fail because the directories may not exist yet.
Task T002a is marked [P] yet requires the output of T002 (requirements.txt). Parallel execution is unsafe.
Task T003a [P] validates .ruff.toml, which is generated by T003. The test must run after the config file exists.
Task T004a [P] validates the CI workflow schema, but the workflow file is created by T004. Parallel execution would cause a missing file error.
Task T005a [P] checks README content, yet README is produced by T005. The test cannot safely run before the README exists.
Task T064a [P] unit‑tests the seed lists defined in T064 (config module). Because T064 is still pending, the [P] tag is incorrect.
Task T007a [P] contract‑tests the logging utility, which is implemented in T007. The test must wait for T007 to finish.
Task T008a [P] unit‑tests the resource monitor, but the monitor is created in T008. Parallel execution is unsafe.
Task T009a [P] integration‑tests the GSM8K download script, which is the very script defined in T009. The test cannot run before the script exists.
Task T070a [P] unit‑tests the TinyLlama‑430M quantized model loading, yet the model loader is implemented in T070, which is still pending.
Task T071a [P] contract‑tests the mask utilities, but the utilities are defined in T071, which is not yet completed.
User Story 2 (Phase 4) re‑uses the mask generated in US 1 (tasks T018/T018a). This creates a cross‑story dependency, violating the requirement that each user‑story block be independently shippable.

The configuration module `src/config.py` (T064) is still undone, yet many downstream tasks (e.g., seed‑loop orchestrators, mask‑derivation seeds) assume its existence. This breaks the foundational‑first ordering principle.

The dataset‑download script (T009) is not yet implemented, but numerous downstream tasks (splitting, checksum validation, mask derivation) depend on the data being present. The plan should enforce completion of T009 before any consumer tasks.
